summary: Devices used by privileged accounts are prioritised correctly, and every mail says where it comes from.

new.title: Devices take their most privileged user's tier
new.text: When a Tier 0, 1 or 2 account signs in to a device, the device gets that tier. Devices of HR and finance accounts become Tier 2, so they are patched before Tier 3 devices.

new.title: Every mail names its environment
new.text: The subject and first line of every mail start with the environment's kind and name, and the body names the tenant. You never mistake one installation's mail for another's.

new.title: Community and Pro work the same way
new.text: Both editions now install, run and update the same way; only the licensed features differ. A setting is marked Pro only when it belongs to a licensed feature.

new.title: Community can connect to Invardia by choice
new.text: The installer asks whether to connect a Community installation to Invardia for health reports and updates on request. Without a yes, it sends nothing that identifies your tenant or installation.

fixes.title: Health report shows the database upkeep is current
fixes.text: The health report now shows that the database upkeep that keeps pages fast is current, with the time it last ran.

fixes.title: Long steps no longer look stalled
fixes.text: A long step's progress is no longer lost when the clocks of two services differ by a few seconds.

fixes.title: Presentation files always save on Windows
fixes.text: The management presentation's file name is now always one Windows can save, also when its title has characters such as a colon or a question mark.
